info.name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE) asset-level STAC catalogue Bulk Transaction Extension Collections API

params.name: collection_id
params.description: Collection ID

params.name: item_id
params.description: Item ID

params.name: bbox
params.description: Only return items intersecting this bounding box. Mutually exclusive with **intersects**.

params.name: datetime
params.description:
Only return items that have a temporal property that intersects this value.

Either a date-time or an interval, open or closed. Date and time expressions adhere to RFC 3339. Open intervals are expressed using double-dots.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of results that are included in each page of the response.

params.name: query
params.description: Allows additional filtering based on the properties of Item objects

params.name: sortby
params.description: An array of property names, prefixed by either '+' for ascending or '-' for descending. If no prefix is provided, '+' is assumed.

params.name: fields
params.description: Include or exclude fields from items body.

params.name: filter
params.description:
A CQL filter expression for filtering items.

Supports `CQL-JSON` as defined in https://portal.ogc.org/files/96288

Remember to URL encode the CQL-JSON if using GET

params.name: filter-crs
params.description: The coordinate reference system (CRS) used by spatial literals in the 'filter' value. Default is `http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/OGC/1.3/CRS84`

params.name: filter-lang
params.description: The CQL filter encoding that the 'filter' value uses.
